entries.title: Now available for Minecraft 1.20.1
entries.summary: Adventure Item Names now runs on Minecraft 1.20.1 as well as 1.21.1 — the same procedural item names, provenance lore, themed packs, and in-game naming editor, just on the older version. Fabric and Forge are supported on 1.20.1; NeoForge remains 1.21.1.
highlights: New: Fabric and Forge builds for Minecraft 1.20.1
Same naming engine, lore, bundled themed packs, and in-game editor on both 1.21.1 and 1.20.1
Existing 1.21.1 builds (Fabric / Forge / NeoForge) are unchanged

entries.title: Item naming restored on Minecraft 1.20.1
entries.summary: Several naming paths silently stopped working on Minecraft 1.20.1 after multi-version support landed. Armor from villagers, crafting, and loot now gets named and described on 1.20.1 just like on 1.21.1, and custom or hand-authored datapacks now load correctly instead of being rejected as incompatible.
highlights: Armor (helmets, chestplates, leggings, boots) now gets procedural names on 1.20.1
Custom & hand-authored datapacks now load on 1.20.1 (correct pack format)
Crafted-item descriptions, bow and shield naming now work on 1.20.1

entries.title: Testificate joins the Minecraft lore names
entries.summary: Added "Testificate" to the Minecraft lore name pool — the name Notch accidentally left on villagers in the Beta 1.9 pre-releases. It can now show up anywhere the mc_lore pool feeds in: mob names, "forged by", weapon titles and more.

entries.title: Supporter name spelling fix: TJYongHeng
entries.summary: Corrected a Discord supporter's name in the community name pool — TJYoungHeng is now spelled TJYongHeng. Generated names that credit them (forged by, mob names, weapon titles) now get it right.
highlights: discord_people pool: TJYoungHeng renamed to TJYongHeng
